summary: Implemented stable realistic live flashlight mode for examples/flashlight/run.py with local-exposure suppression, realistic Lumen/reflection retention, startup warmup gating before teleop control, inverse-square spotlight controls, explicit shadow/contact-shadow controls, diagnostics, a new realistic_live_flashlight profile, and focused unit coverage.
work_completed: Inspected the requested live flashlight, profile, orbit collection, test, workflow, Scout result, and DefaultEngine.ini context before editing.
Extended live fixed-exposure config to suppress local exposure in launch INI and runtime console commands whenever auto exposure is disabled or realistic live mode is active.

Added --live-lighting-mode realistic and --startup-warmup-seconds with a 3.0 second realistic default, then gated live control until warmup frames complete after scene-light scaling and flashlight setup.
Added realistic live renderer config/runtime commands that keep Lumen GI, Lumen reflections, reflection method, materials, specular, and related show flags enabled.
Added shared inverse-square flashlight profile support with reflected method/property fallbacks and no unsafe dynamic property probing for inverse-square properties.
Made direct shadow, dynamic shadow, contact-shadow toggle, and contact-shadow length controls explicit with safe fallbacks; preserved --disable-flashlight-contact-shadows.
Added realistic_live_flashlight profile and propagated inverse-square profile resolution into shared settings and orbit flashlight spawning diagnostics.
Added diagnostics for exposure/local exposure runtime commands, scene-light state, profile details, inverse-square state, shadow/contact-shadow state, Lumen retention, and warmup duration.
Ran targeted unittest suite successfully: python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation.

findings.message: Targeted tests passed: python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation ran 78 tests OK.
Unreal runtime validation was intentionally not run because the task constrained Builder to avoid long Unreal processes.
User-facing CLI/profile changes should be reflected in flashlight docs or workflow notes.

follow_up_recommendations: Exact live validation command: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/spear && conda activate spear-env && python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3
If contact-shadow reflection crashes in a specific Unreal build, rerun the same command with --disable-flashlight-contact-shadows to isolate lighting stability from contact-shadow support.
memory_worthy: Live realistic flashlight mode now suppresses local exposure, warms up before teleop control, keeps Lumen GI/reflections/material response enabled, and uses the realistic_live_flashlight profile with inverse-square fallback support.
